verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a programmatic API and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence pack covers API versioning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe found no spec, and the 'legacy tool' note on Alerts concerns a UI feature, not API deprecation. Having an API alone does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
